lead.zh: 从「把 AI 当搜索框」走到「把 AI 接进文档、表格、会议与邮件」。先认清能力边界，再按场景练一遍完整流程。
lead.en: Move from using AI as a search box to wiring it into documents, spreadsheets, meetings and email. Learn the limits first, then rehearse one complete workflow per scenario.

steps: AI Agent 与聊天机器人的区别
怎么用 AI 做会议纪要
怎么用 AI 做 PPT
怎么用 AI 分析表格
怎么用 AI 写邮件与排日程

zh: 拿到一份会议转写，能标出哪些句子必须回原文核对、哪些可以直接进纪要
说清一次 PPT/表格任务里，AI 负责哪几步、人负责哪几步
判断一条办公数据能否贴进云端模型，依据是数据驻留与授权而不是「大家都这么用」
en: Given a meeting transcript, mark which sentences must be checked against the transcript and which can go straight into minutes
Explain which steps AI owns and which a human owns in a deck or spreadsheet task
Decide whether office data can go into a cloud model based on residency and licensing, not on “everyone does it”

answers.zh: 数字、承诺、姓名、日期和「谁负责」必须回原文；总结性描述可以基于转写生成，但也要能指回原句。
answers.en: Numbers, commitments, names, dates and ownership must trace to the transcript; summaries can be generated but must still point back to a line.
answers.review: 怎么用 AI 做会议纪要

answers.zh: AI 负责结构、初稿、变体和检查清单；人负责目标、取舍、事实核对和对外发送。
answers.en: AI owns structure, first drafts, variants and checklists; the human owns goals, trade-offs, fact-checking and sending.
answers.review: 怎么用 AI 做 PPT

answers.zh: 先看数据分类、合同/合规要求、模型是否留存与跨境；不能确认时改用本地模型、脱敏或不上传。
answers.en: Check data class, contract/compliance rules, retention and cross-border transfer. If unclear, use a local model, mask the data or do not upload.

nextTask.zh: 挑一个办公工具，按「输入—步骤—验收」跑一遍真实任务
nextTask.en: Pick one office tool and run a real task through input, steps and acceptance
